title: Hardware Profiler
text: Profiles function-call subsystem using GPIO, ERAD, or Timer measurement modes, 2 outputs, {Measurement mode} sets Select hardware profiling technique Embedded Real-time Analysis & Diagnostic; {ERAD module}, {GPIO number} and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Measurement mode
params.values: Select hardware profiling technique Embedded Real-time Analysis & Diagnostic (ERAD) (default) | General Purpose Input Output (GPIO) | Timer

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time at which block reads data from hardware profiler -1 (default)
